meta.name: customize-core-review
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "customize a review", "override review defaults", "add project-specific review rules", "extend review-logic", or "create local review overrides". Create or modify a local review override for a core review type.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加项目专属审查规则，覆盖默认配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不同项目里定制代码审查标准
copy.tagline_en: Add project-specific review rules to override defaults
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need per-project overrides for code review logic

howto.what: 装上此技能后，当用户要求定制代码审查时，Claude 会引导确认审查类型（逻辑、模式、文档或技能），询问是扩展默认规则还是整体覆盖，收集具体规则后写入本地技能文件，实现项目专属审查规则。
howto.when: 当用户要求“定制审查”、“覆盖审查默认值”或“添加项目特定审查规则”等时触发。

say.text: 我要定制 code review 的逻辑规则
say.note: Claude 会询问扩展还是覆盖，然后帮你生成本地规则。

say.text: 把审查默认规则换成我们项目的规则
say.note: 选择覆盖模式后，提供你的规则。

say.text: 给这个项目加几条模式检查规则
say.note: Claude 会收集规则并写入本地技能。

howto.what_en: When asked to customize a review, Claude guides you to pick a type (logic, patterns, documentation, skill), choose extend or override, collect your rules, and write a local SKILL.md file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to customize a review, override review defaults, add project-specific review rules, etc.

say_en.text: I want to customize the logic rules for code review.
say_en.note: Claude asks extend or override, then creates local rules.

say_en.text: Replace the default review rules with our project's rules.
say_en.note: Choose override mode and provide your rules.

say_en.text: Add some pattern-checking rules for this project.
say_en.note: Claude gathers rules and writes them to the local skill.
